name: target
description: Target element whose scroll position is monitored.

name: threshold
description: Scroll offset in pixels required before the scroll-top button becomes visible.

name: icon
description: Optional icon CSS class rendered inside the button; falls back to an inline SVG chevron when omitted.

name: behavior
description: Scroll behavior passed to scrollTo when returning to the top.

name: styleClass
description: Additional CSS classes applied to the button element.

name: ariaLabel
description: Accessible label for the scroll-top button.

name: scrollToTop
description: Programmatically scrolls the target container or window back to the top.
